pricingQueries.product: Azure App Service Premium v4 Plan
pricingQueries.conversionNote: App Service Premium v4 P1mv4 is billed per hour; one compute unit maps to one instance-hour.
Cosmos DB autoscale AP2 is billed per hour of provisioned throughput, matching the estimator's per-database-hour unit.
Blob Storage Hot LRS is billed per GB/month, matching the estimator unit directly.
Inter-region data transfer is billed per GB, matching the estimator unit directly.
ASSUMPTION: Log Analytics bills per GB ingested, not per event. 1,000 telemetry events are modelled as 1 MB, so the per-GB price is divided by 1,000.
Defender for Servers is billed per protected node hour, matching the estimator unit directly.
Service Bus Basic is billed per 1M messaging operations; one workload request is modelled as one operation.
Azure AI Search is billed per provisioned search unit-hour. Search units equal partitions multiplied by replicas.

architectures.name: Agentic Orchestration on Microservices
architectures.description: Use this scalable form of agentic orchestration when autonomous agents, governed tools, APIs, events, workflows, and data must run behind independently deployable service boundaries.
strengths: Supports mixed transactional and AI workloads
Scales agent orchestration and governed tool execution across domain services
weaknesses: Requires mature DevSecOps and service ownership

architectures.name: Workflow + AI
architectures.description: A durable workflow coordinates document processing, AI extraction, rules, and approval queues.

architectures.name: Retrieval-Augmented Generation
architectures.description: Retrieval, reranking, and generation over governed enterprise knowledge.

architectures.name: Focused Agentic Orchestration
architectures.description: Use this focused agentic pattern when one stateful orchestrator plans multi-step work, invokes governed tools, and requests approval without independently scalable domain-service boundaries.
strengths: Flexible tool integration with a simpler topology

architectures.name: Traditional Service Architecture
architectures.description: Stateless services, relational persistence, queues, and deterministic business rules.
weaknesses: Advanced prediction requires an ML extension
